verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at docs.bentolabs.ai (HTTP 200, structured content), and the llms.txt index links per-page Markdown docs. Bento also ships agent-oriented onboarding: a paste-in prompt for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf installs Agent Skills, hands the agent the integration playbook, and loads the docs over MCP. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that agents actually complete integrations from these docs and skills.
